Remark
[Lie derivative and Hessian] 1. ch2:3.8 Source: topping:page-0032 \group topping-background

For a $1$-form $\omega $, \[ \mathcal L_{\omega ^\# }g(X,W)= abla \omega (X,W)+ abla \omega (W,X). \] In particular, for $\omega =df$, \[ \mathcal L_{(df)^\# }g=2\Hess (f). \]
